items.headline: Jackson Arnold rallies UNLV past No. 23 New Mexico, 21-17
items.description: — Jackson Arnold threw a long fourth-quarter touchdown pass and ran for another score and UNLV beat No. 23 New Mexico 21-17 on Saturday night, spoiling the Lobos’ first home game in The Associated Press poll.
